rule: development seeds and development draws only; nothing here has seen a sealed draw

joint_oc.estimand: P over the sealed seed of the registered run's outcome as judged (L_sub at the production level), W*, code and solver fixed; not P(PASS) against continuum-exact ratios
joint_oc.c_definition: c_k = L_sub,run(W*_k) / L_sub,dev(W*_k) - 1 ~ U(-tau_k, tau_k), tau_k = solver_tol_rel_L_max of the W* solve

measured_sizing.basis: Review item 2: per (layout, level) the burst's measured wall, CPU and peak RSS of every l2_layout result (with (measured_sizing)
measured_sizing.redraw_model: wave w solves ceil(n_draws q^w) attempts, q per attempt; q_out = the development draws' out-of-window fraction at the production level
measured_sizing.pricing_basis: 0.612 $/h at 80 GB is the founder's figure; 0.0086 $/GB-h for N2D extended memory is an assumption to check in the console. N2D extended memory reaches 768 GB per VM (cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instances/creating-instance-with-custom-machine-type)

vm_config.machine: n2d-custom-8-81920-ext (regular, not Spot, for the registered run)
